outputs.question: how do i initiate a rework for a job?

answer.message: Here is guidance from the TenOps Guide.

sources.title: Initiate Job Rework
sources.guidance: Authorized business writers can create Rework for a completed Production Job. Open the Job in Production and select Create Rework. Choose a Reason, describe Rework Scope / Work Required, enter Intake / Return Date, then select Create Rework. The Job must be complete, unarchived and have no active Rework cycle. Only one Rework cycle can be active at a time. Rework remains on the same canonical Job and preserves original Production status and dates. Scope is a whole-Job description, not structured piece or Color Plate tracking.
sources.path: Production → completed Job → Create Rework → Create Rework

outputs.question: how do i filter by jobs in manpower reporting

answer.message: Here is guidance from the TenOps Guide.

sources.title: Filter Manpower Reporting by Job
sources.guidance: Employees with business-write access can filter labor by Production Job. Open Reporting → Manpower Reporting, then choose the Job in Job labor review. Use Clear job filter or All reporting groups to reset. After selecting a Job, Product Category filter narrows products. Analytics use the selected reporting period; reporting rows are loaded complete groups with all their dates. Search and filters are not exhaustive until all available history is loaded. Read-only accounts cannot change the current Job labor review selector, but can use Search manpower or open a Job’s Current Hours link from Production.

outputs.question: how do i edit a saved customers details

answer.message: Here is guidance from the TenOps Guide.

sources.title: Edit a saved customer’s details
sources.guidance: Open Toolbox → Resources → Contacts. Search for the beginning of the customer’s company name, then select the company name to open Customer Inspector. Edit Customer / Company Name, or expand Additional Information (Optional) to edit Contact Name, Phone Number or Email Address. Choose Save Changes. Lead/Admin access is required to edit a saved customer; read-only accounts cannot save changes. Saved changes apply to future selections. Existing Jobs and Proposals keep their captured information.
